hooks.statusMessage: Checking PROJECT-PROGRESS.md is up to date...
hooks.command: b=$(git status --porcelain -- _bmad-output _bmad/custom 2>/dev/null | wc -l | tr -d ' '); p=$(git status --porcelain -- PROJECT-PROGRESS.md 2>/dev/null | wc -l | tr -d ' '); if [ "${b:-0}" -gt 0 ] 2>/dev/null && [ "${p:-0}" -eq 0 ] 2>/dev/null; then echo "{\"continue\": false, \"stopReason\": \"BMAD output files under _bmad-output/ or _bmad/custom/ changed this session but PROJECT-PROGRESS.md was not updated. Append a new Step entry (Phase / Workflow / Goal / Command / Trigger + Agent Log + Skill Log + Execution Summary) and update the Summary Tables, following the schema already established in that file, before stopping.\"}"; else echo "{\"continue\": true}"; fi
